additional_info.subject: Reported issue
additional_info.body: Dear supp, our customer still raising a questions about the connectivity drops to the backend (driivz). They operate 4pcs Si-D, different locations but others are fine. I have a screen of Teltonika signal from the tech.expert Francisco de Matos Joaquim. Not able attach in this form now - ends with fault. I can attach later in the email. But this charger (170001597) is changing online/offline state despite the signal is good. For exmple it changed the status this morning around at 8:30 UTC time. Despite the SIM cards don't have the unlimited data the other chargers are fine. I guess if there were no data on the SIM card because of the limit the charger would never connect again. Please could you check the OCPP parameters and compare it with the charger 170001596 (hXcXbF) installed next to this one. Actually, I have the information the CPO noticed it goes offline after "Preparing" status. But I dont know what really sends the charger to the backend. Thank you for the support.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0388871 - ID0388871-DC/Si-D/CZ- [MP / R3 170001597]  connectivity drops to the backend CRM:02023000280
additional_info.body:
Hello Tomas,
Greetings of the day.
We have checked the logs of past 3 days and found that charger is now online, but it was offline on 9th Nov till 16:24 UTC time.
We analyzed the logs of 9th Nov and found that we have error “Unexpected server response: 503”, which is due to following reasons:
2024-11-09T13:46:54.248291+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/42ff8aa0cdc3[729]: OCPP-Central-System connection error:
Unexpected server response: 503
Server Overload
: The server is receiving more requests than it can handle at the moment.
Server Maintenance
: The server might be temporarily down for updates or maintenance.
Network Issues
: There could be temporary network problems between you and the server.
Server Misconfiguration
: Something might have gone wrong with the server's configuration or resources.
As you mentioned that other chargers were online and only this was offline so we can rule out server issue.
From the logs also, we can see that there was network issue, please find the logs mentioned below to confirm this.
2024-11-09T13:45:33.636426+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/42ff8aa0cdc3[729]: [ensureOCPPConnection] router2 - [isMobileConnected] routerIp: 10.20.17.2 connstate: {"stdout":"
disconnected
\n","stderr":""}
2024-11-09T13:45:33.637931+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/42ff8aa0cdc3[729]: [ensureOCPPConnection] router2 - router is mobile
disconnected
, router reset initiated
2024-11-09T13:45:33.638632+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/42ff8aa0cdc3[729]: [ensureOCPPConnection] router2 - router is
disconnected
, performing actions...
2024-11-09T13:45:35.771995+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/42ff8aa0cdc3[729]: [ensureOCPPConnection] router2 - getting IMSI...
2024-11-09T13:45:39.064494+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/42ff8aa0cdc3[729]: [ensureOCPPConnection] router2 -
IMSI
: {"stdout":"
ERROR
\n","stderr":""}
When router tried to get IMSI details from the SIM card, it also results in Error (As highlighted above).
2024-11-09T13:45:39.065745+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/42ff8aa0cdc3[729]: [ensureOCPPConnection] router2 - performing operator scan...
2024-11-09T13:47:32.235892+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/42ff8aa0cdc3[729]: [ensureOCPPConnection]
router2 - operator scan result
: {"stdout":
"N/A
\n","stderr":"Can't match integer (got )\nGSMCTL error: reading message\n"}
And we can see the same with operator scan on router 2 as well.
So, to summarize this, we can say that charger was offline on 9th Nov due to network issue.
We also ondertand that you have discussed about signal strength with one of our colleagues and signal strength are good, we are not denying that, but we can only investigate reason for disconnection only when charger is disconnected.
As the charger is online for past 2 days it is not possible to determine the exact reason of disconnection.
Let us know whether you have any other questions, or can we close this ticket?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
